lines: [game announcer] [fast] New game: earn a billion dollars at minimum wage. Spoiler: the answer has five digits. In years.
[fast] Seven twenty-five an hour. One day: fifty-eight bucks. One year: fifteen thousand.
[confident] Work your whole life. Forty-five years. Six hundred seventy-eight thousand!
[nervous] That's not even a tenth of one percent of a billion.
[shocked] You'd need sixty-six thousand years. Full time. No vacations.
[deadpan] Stonehenge is only about five thousand years old. You'd clock in before humans invented farming.
[deadpan] Your retirement party? Sixty-six thousand years late. Bring a cake.
[whisper] ...so, new game. Earn a billion dollars... at minimum wage.
